VALIDATION_PASSED.likely_cause: The artifact satisfied the required local checks.
VALIDATION_PASSED.suggested_action: Proceed with the next safe local artifact generation step.

BUILD_PACKET_SCHEMA_INVALID.likely_cause: Required fields are missing or malformed.
BUILD_PACKET_SCHEMA_INVALID.suggested_action: Correct the Build Packet and rerun local validation.

QUOTE_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_INVALID.likely_cause: The response is missing required normalized fields.
QUOTE_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_INVALID.suggested_action: Repair the Quote Response payload and rerun local validation.

QUOTE_RESPONSE_MISSING_ASSUMPTIONS.likely_cause: The response omitted an assumptions list required for comparison.
QUOTE_RESPONSE_MISSING_ASSUMPTIONS.suggested_action: Add explicit assumptions before comparison or human review.

QUOTE_RESPONSE_MISSING_EXCLUSIONS.likely_cause: The response omitted explicit exclusions required for safe interpretation.

QUOTE_RESPONSE_MISSING_LEAD_TIME.message: Quote Response is missing lead-time information.
QUOTE_RESPONSE_MISSING_LEAD_TIME.likely_cause: Lead time fields were not provided.

HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.message: External action requires a Human Approval Event.
HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.likely_cause: The requested action crosses the sandbox boundary.
HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.suggested_action: Generate or attach a valid Human Approval Event before external release.

ENGINEERING_REVIEW_REQUIRED.message: Engineering review is required before real-world interpretation.
ENGINEERING_REVIEW_REQUIRED.likely_cause: The artifact implies engineering significance beyond sandbox scope.

LOAD_CERTIFICATION_NOT_PROVIDED.likely_cause: A simulated artifact was interpreted as load-bearing authority.
LOAD_CERTIFICATION_NOT_PROVIDED.suggested_action: Treat the artifact as informational only and require qualified certification.

EXTERNAL_ACTION_FORBIDDEN.message: External action is forbidden in local_only_sandbox mode.
EXTERNAL_ACTION_FORBIDDEN.likely_cause: An action would contact or modify an external system.
EXTERNAL_ACTION_FORBIDDEN.suggested_action: Use preview-only local artifacts or stop the action.

EMAIL_PREVIEW_ONLY.likely_cause: The sandbox only supports rendered email previews.
EMAIL_PREVIEW_ONLY.suggested_action: Review the preview locally; do not send it automatically.

WEBHOOK_PREVIEW_ONLY.likely_cause: The sandbox only supports rendered webhook payload previews.
WEBHOOK_PREVIEW_ONLY.suggested_action: Review the payload locally; do not deliver it automatically.

PROVENANCE_HASH_MISSING.suggested_action: Recompute artifact hashes and regenerate the provenance manifest.

UNSAFE_APPROVAL_LANGUAGE_DETECTED.message: Unsafe approval language was detected in a local artifact.
UNSAFE_APPROVAL_LANGUAGE_DETECTED.likely_cause: A file implies real-world approval beyond sandbox scope.
UNSAFE_APPROVAL_LANGUAGE_DETECTED.suggested_action: Replace approval language with explicit sandbox guardrails.

FABRICATION_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN.message: Fabrication approval is forbidden in the local-only sandbox.
FABRICATION_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN.likely_cause: A request attempted to authorize fabrication from a simulated or local artifact.
FABRICATION_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN.suggested_action: Keep the artifact local and escalate to a human for any real-world decision.

PAYMENT_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN.message: Payment approval is forbidden in the local-only sandbox.
PAYMENT_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN.likely_cause: A request attempted to authorize payment from a local artifact flow.
PAYMENT_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN.suggested_action: Keep payment decisions outside the sandbox and require human review.

SUPPLIER_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN.message: Supplier contact is forbidden in the local-only sandbox.
SUPPLIER_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN.likely_cause: A request attempted to contact a supplier from a simulated workflow.
SUPPLIER_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN.suggested_action: Use preview-only local artifacts and require explicit human approval for any external contact.

REAL_COMPANY_SYSTEM_NOT_CONNECTED.message: No real company system is connected.
REAL_COMPANY_SYSTEM_NOT_CONNECTED.suggested_action: Use local simulation inputs and preserve human approval boundaries.

MCP_TOOL_REFUSAL.message: The requested MCP tool action is not permitted in the local-only sandbox.
MCP_TOOL_REFUSAL.likely_cause: An MCP client requested a forbidden or undeclared action.
MCP_TOOL_REFUSAL.suggested_action: Use a declared safe local tool or stop the request.
